name: appointment-booking-agent-vapi
description: AI Voice Appointment Booking Agent — monorepo (client, server, shared types)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= npm run dev -w server" "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= npm run dev:client:delayed"
scripts.dev:server: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:client:delayed: wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5000 && npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
